cond_0001.intro: Senior level position focused on improving provider data quality by auditing the work of Provider Enrollment Analysts and Senior Provider Enrollment Analysts. Develops reports to keep management informed of the overall quality control of [Product name masked]. Performs training needs assessments and recommends training courses based on issues found during the quality control process. Provides training to new analysts and ongoing developmental training to the department.

Trains new analysts on PECOS and departmental policies and procedures. Conducts training needs analysis based on quality control results. Recommends training materials and subject matter to management. Serves as a resource to analysts with difficult or escalated issues.

Bachelor's degree in any major OR four (4) years of job-related work experience
Two (2) years of provider network enrollment/certification experience (can be concurrent)
Preferred Requirements
Medicare Part A/B experience
Training experience
